title: Dizzy's dislike of pressure, Cheraw drunkenness and pot on the plane
summary: Sam recalls Dizzy playing congas, a drunken night in his hometown Cheraw, and passing his pot pipe on planes.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: That's the interesting thing about Dizzy now, in terms of what happens sometimes he, he'll be doing a lot of talking and playing the congo drum you know, but it seem like anytime he want a pick up that horn he gets pushed enough, you know. Jones: Yeah well, he don't like pressure man, cause, see he play everything he know and then he know, knows man, that thing backwards.
And he would really, I remember we play uhm, went down to his hometown Cheraw, South Carolina.

Down there and there's some very embarrassing moments in Dizzy's band, you know, down there, uhm, I know the time, uh, we was all in a parade man and they had us in the cars, open cars, and parading us all through town and the mayor and all this stuff, their "home town boy does good" and all that stuff.
So he got down there and all his friends and relatives you know, he was drinking that moonshine.
And he come down to play that night man, and he was too drunk to play man, he couldn't even find his mouth.

That was the most embarrassing, the most embarrassing moment I ever had in that band man, and uhm, another thing, he had, my nerves just started going man, messing around in Dizzy's band, uh, we would be on an airplane and he'd put his little pipe full of pot.

And light it right in the plane and take a big drag and reach over across the aisle and hand you the pipe you know. I nutter on him myself, I acted like I didn't know him one time, on one of them flights, you know, I shoot, he had it, took a big drag, handed it to me and I just looked out the window at the clouds.
